description: Found by the fz-go4.18.28.5 implementer, independently confirmed by the removable-code audit. runtime_demand.rs::settle_demand_cone (~:480) sorts ascent members by (function.as_u32(), key.activation.arrow, need_order) — arrow is Ty(u32), a RAW TYPE-INTERNER ID whose value depends on the sequence types get interned during the fixpoint, not on source-structural position. Classification: iteration-order-affecting-convergence — the same shape of risk as the .28.5 defect (schedule-derived key feeding an ascent). Unverified whether it is convergence-speed-only (Kleene ascent should reach the same fixpoint in any order if truly monotone) or a correctness leak (any non-monotone step would make the answer order-dependent). TASK: prove which. If speed-only, either document why the order is harmless or replace with a structural key anyway (sorting-law hygiene: sorts should not consume interner ids mid-flow); if correctness-affecting, this is a bug in the .28.6 nondeterminism family — connect to that ticket's mechanism (a fact consulted through a channel not wired into its invalidation). Sequencing: natural companion to fz-go4.18.28.6.
title: settle_demand_cone sorts ascent members by raw interned Ty (process-hash-dependent convergence order)
